brief: 🔥 FIRECRAWL (firecrawl/firecrawl) — Best bet: Web scraping API for AI agents. Every RAG pipeline and agent needs fresh web data. Ship this as a managed service, charge per crawl.
⏰ BREAKOUT NOW: Web data pipelines are the missing link between LLMs and real-time knowledge. First-mover advantage in agent-native scraping.
⚡ Complementary plays: mattpocock/skills (agent framework) + Graphify-Labs/graphify (codebase graphs) = full dev stack for AI-native tooling.
💡 Skip: Books (bojieli/ai-agent-book) and self-hosted companions (moeru-ai/airi) — too niche or too far from immediate developer pain.

items.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.one_liner: Unified social media API for AI agents to search all platforms
items.pain_point: AI developers waste weeks integrating fragmented, expensive APIs. Building any social intelligence feature requires 6+ platform integrations with different auth, rate limits, and $0.01-0.05/req costs. They'd pay for unified, cheap, reliable access.
app_ideas: AI-powered brand monitoring SaaS: real-time alerts when your company/product gets mentioned across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub with sentiment analysis
Competitive intelligence dashboard: auto-track competitor launches, reviews, and user complaints across all platforms in one view
Creator trend aggregator: show a creator what's trending about their niche across platforms so they can ride waves
items.monetization: B2B API wrapper with usage-based pricing ($0.001/req target), free tier for dev, then tiered plans by volume. Add a managed dashboard product on top.
items.why_now: AI agent market exploding (50B+ invested in 2024), every agent needs web data, and existing scraping solutions are getting blocked or priced out
